errors.text_span: with each data point annotated by its corresponding IDK recall value
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the numbers annotating the data points (0.1, 0.2, etc.) are IDK recall values. These numbers do not match the y-axis values of the points. The original paper caption indicates these are 'τ' values.
The description incorrectly states the y-axis range is from 0.1 to 0.6. While these are the tick mark labels, several data points are plotted with y-values (IDK recall) clearly above 0.6.
